test_title: PYST 46: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Mar, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. B is sitting to the immediate left of C. G and H are not the immediate neighbour of C. H is sitting second to the right of P. Who is sitting on the immediate left of P?
solution:
Given: Five friends P, B, C, G and H.

1) B is sitting to the immediate left of C.

2) G and H are not the immediate neighbour of C.

3) H is sitting second to the right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cde438418058ca76259e76a892ac9af27b0551deeea717f1bafb8fce7fc7fc71.png] 

So, C is sitting on the immediate left of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "C".
